SEARCH
Package ch.ahdis.matchbox.engine.packages

Class LazyTerminologyLoader

java.lang.Object
ch.ahdis.matchbox.engine.packages.LazyTerminologyLoader
public final class LazyTerminologyLoader extends Object
Registers the terminology resources (CodeSystem, ValueSet, NamingSystem, ConceptMap) of a package as CompressedPackageResourceProxy objects, which are parsed when they're first used (lazy loading).

The other resource types, above all the StructureDefinitions, are parsed when the package is loaded: the validator iterates over all StructureDefinitions in many places (e.g. FHIRPathEngine, ContextUtilities.getStructures()), so they would be parsed by the first validation anyway, like the core validator parses them at startup.
